title: feat(console): surfaces that never draw a record count decline the list total
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9USTJYAvMcxS7CFGZygeZG6)_

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQAXHSQEgnYyx9tstb

Fixes #33700

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 适配器现在能把 `$count: false` 送到服务端；时间线、记录选择器、repeater 这三处只画行、从不显示总数的界面，分页读取时不再让服务端跑 `count(*)`。SQL 基准加了每个分页列表场景的 `_nocount` 对照腿。
- 为什么改：索引落地后，PostgreSQL 上分页列表的数据库时间一半到四分之三花在总数 `count(*)` 上；以前适配器根本不转发 `$count`,任何界面都无法关掉它。
- 风险与回滚：只影响三处不显示总数的界面，它们改走适配器已有的原始 GET 路径(展开/搜索早就走它);显示总数的界面(表格页脚、相关列表、查找框「共 N 条」、看板、日历/地图/甘特的截断提示)一律不动。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`(`find()` 的路由条件与 `normalizeQueryResult` 不再用页长冒充总数)、`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx`、`packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/src/countOptOut.test.ts` —— 预期 4 个用例全绿，其中第一个断言请求带 `count=false` 且结果没有 `total`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(封顶总数已由区裁决不做，见 Acceptance notes)。

## What changes

- **Adapter.** `ObjectStackAdapter.find()` routes a read with `$count: false` through its raw GET (the route `$expand` / `$search` reads already take, because the SDK's `data.find()` has no count option) and sends `count=false`. `normalizeQueryResult` leaves the declined `total` absent instead of filling in the page length; an absent `$count` and `$count: true` behave as before (no `count` parameter, server total read).
- **Call sites.** Every Console surface that pages a list was checked for whether it prints the total. The ones that draw rows only now send `$count: false` beside a paged read: the timeline rail (`object-timeline` and the timeline view), `element:record_picker`, `element:repeater` (record picker and repeater only when a limit pages the read). Left untouched because they print the total: the grid and list footers (`ListView`, `objectGridRowLoad`), related lists, the lookup picker's "showing N of M", kanban lane counts, `useViewData`, and the calendar / map / tree / gantt row-ceiling note (`NonGridRowCeilingNote` prints the total when truncated). Not touched for other reasons: the gallery and the dashboard table send no `$top` (the server counts nothing there); the Cmd-K fanout in `useRecordSearch` only runs on adapters without `searchAll`, which the Console's adapter has.
- **Docs.** `QueryParams.$count` (`@object-ui/types`), the adapter README's parameter table and `content/docs/frontend/data-objectstack.mdx` (Custom Queries, under its `find() resolves to { data, total? }` example) describe the opt-out.
- **Bench.** `packages/qa/dogfood/bench/sql-perf/bench.mjs` runs every paged-list scenario a second time as `NAME_nocount` with `count=false`; the README documents the pair.

Server side nothing changes: `$count=false` is the declared opt-out (`ODataQuerySchema.$count`), already honoured by `protocol-data-crud.ts`. The page statement is byte-identical with and without the opt-out (SQL log below), so read scope and the tenant predicate stay in the pushed-down statement exactly as today; a non-SQL driver is unaffected (the opt-out only skips `engine.count`).

## Measurement (local, this container, shared box; p50 over 20 requests)

M0 bench, 100000 line items, member owns every 10th account, base `e8cba8fe` (after the index PR). Columns: client p50 ms / db ms p50 / SQL statements, with total vs `_nocount`.

| scenario | who | PG with total | PG `_nocount` | SQLite with total | SQLite `_nocount` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| scoped_list_unfiltered | admin | 37.8 / 25.2 / 10 | 15.4 / 6.9 / 9 | 164.1 / 146.6 / 10 | 147.6 / 134.9 / 9 |
| scoped_list_unfiltered | member | 33.0 / 19.4 / 14 | 17.2 / 10.1 / 11 | 31.0 / 16.1 / 14 | 24.6 / 13.8 / 11 |
| list_filter_sort | admin | 44.4 / 29.1 / 10 | 14.8 / 6.3 / 9 | 88.4 / 67.2 / 10 | 55.5 / 40.2 / 9 |
| list_filter_sort | member | 32.1 / 18.2 / 14 | 18.6 / 9.7 / 11 | 22.0 / 6.8 / 14 | 16.5 / 5.3 / 11 |
| cross_object_filter_small | admin | 41.1 / 28.2 / 10 | 14.3 / 6.4 / 9 | 122.0 / 101.3 / 10 | 111.0 / 90.8 / 9 |
| list_deep_page | admin | 78.7 / 68.2 / 10 | 57.6 / 47.1 / 9 | 104.8 / 82.8 / 10 | 78.2 / 61.9 / 9 |
| scoped_account_list | member | 18.6 / 8.1 / 14 | 12.7 / 6.0 / 11 | 14.2 / 2.2 / 14 | 11.5 / 1.8 / 11 |
| public_list_tiny | member | 11.7 / 5.7 / 10 | 10.6 / 5.5 / 9 | 9.1 / 1.3 / 10 | 10.0 / 1.6 / 9 |

Reading: on PostgreSQL the total is 50 to 78 percent of a paged list's database time (admin 25.2 to 6.9 ms, member 19.4 to 10.1 ms on the unfiltered read-scoped list). On SQLite it is a smaller share; the SQLite admin page itself (135 ms with no count) dominates there, which is a separate cost, not this card's.

SQL shape (PG `--sql-log`, member, unfiltered): page `select * from "bench_line_item" where "opportunity" in (select "id" from "bench_opportunity" where "account" in (select "id" from "bench_account" where "owner_id" = $1)) order by "created_at" desc, "id" desc limit $2`; total `select count(*) as "count" from "bench_line_item" where` + the same predicate. A member's total costs three statements, not one: the count path re-reads `sys_record_share` and `sys_queue` for the read scope the page read already resolved.

### The cheaper total for the screens that print one (decided: not now)

The grid footer, related lists and the lookup picker print an exact count, so `$count=false` cannot help the hottest list. Direct `psql` on the same seeded database (three runs each):

| predicate | matches | full `count(*)` | capped `count(*) from (select 1 ... limit 1001)` |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|
| member read scope | 10000 | 3.6 to 4.1 ms | 1.5 to 1.8 ms |
| admin (no scope) | 100000 | 15.3 to 19.2 ms | 0.6 to 0.8 ms |

A capped total is a new response or parameter shape (for example `$count` taking a cap and the answer saying the total is a lower bound), i.e. a contract change in `packages/spec`, and the screens would print "1000+" instead of an exact number. Both are outside this PR; the area ruled to keep the exact count there (Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/countOptOut.test.ts` — `$count: false` sends `count=false` on the plain and the expand route and the result carries no `total`; controls: absent and `true` send no `count` and read the server total.
- New describe blocks in existing harnesses: `record-picker-sort-members.test.tsx` (record picker), `element-list-inputs-11168.test.tsx` (repeater, with an unpaged control that sends neither `$top` nor `$count`), `queryKeysDeclared-8220.test.tsx` (both timeline registrations).
- Updated because the query now carries the opt-out beside `$top` (exact-shape pins): `record-picker-element-data-source.test.tsx` ("beside a binding, the flat `filter` / `sort` / `limit` are not read") `data-list.elementDataSource-11880.test.tsx` ("SUBJECT: a repeater bound only through `dataSource` lists its rows", "beside a binding, the flat keys change nothing") and `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/DevLists.repeaterBinding-12345.test.tsx` ("its repeater reads `showcase_category`, capped at ten, from the `dataSource` binding", found red by CI's Test UI shard 16/16 and fixed here).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation landed and restored to the HEAD blob each time): deleting the record picker's `query.$count = false;` turns its SUBJECT pin red (1 failed / 8 passed); deleting the adapter's `|| params?.$count === false` routing arm turns "a plain paged read sends `count=false`" red (1 failed / 3 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- Area ruling on the card, comment 6933630606: option A, the exact `count(*)` stays wherever a total is shown, and this PR closes the card; a capped total would be a new contract card.
- Observation, not filed: a member's count path re-reads `sys_record_share` and `sys_queue` for the read scope the page read already resolved (two extra statements per paged list). Disposition: dropped — paid only when a total is asked (the opt-out skips it), no wrong answer; per-statement costs of the list door stay with the epic #33631 census (area o2-F).
- Observation, not filed: on SQLite the admin's 50-row page itself costs about 135 ms of database time with no count. Disposition: dropped — not this card's cost; SQLite's admin page cost is the vacuous controlled_by_parent chain the epic's R4 card (filed beside #33695) owns (area o2-F).

## Verification

All at head `88e8fdcc4` unless named (local, through the shared verification lock):

- The six pinned and edited test files (at `b13c4b2f9`; the DevLists pin alone at `88e8fdcc4`, 1/1 files, 2/2 tests): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over `countOptOut.test.ts`, `record-picker-sort-members.test.tsx`, `record-picker-element-data-source.test.tsx`, `data-list.elementDataSource-11880.test.tsx`, `element-list-inputs-11168.test.tsx`, `queryKeysDeclared-8220.test.tsx` — Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 81 passed (81).
- Package suites (earlier heads, as named) `packages/data-objectstack/ packages/plugin-timeline/ packages/types/ packages/components/` at `85ae9349` (before the pin update): 1029 files passed, 9 failed; 2 of the 9 were the exact-shape pins named above (updated since), the other 7 were spec type-probe and parity suites that read `packages/spec/dist/*.d.mts`, red because the first spec build ran with `OS_SKIP_DTS`. After a spec build with declarations, all 9 plus the pins: Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 241 passed (241).
- `type-check` (at `45823b9e9`) of `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`, `@object-ui/types`: all four Done, exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (94 families, the docs page adds the docs families) each run with stdin closed, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 94 derived, 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The first pass had `check:test-source-alias` red on the four edited component test files (lazy `@object-ui/react-runtime` reach), fixed in this PR with a module-top import, and `check:dts-closure` / `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` red or unmet on build state only (cleared by a full `pnpm build`).
- `test:repo`, `Lint UI` and the full UI shard set are left to CI.
